about.description: Alabama Sweet Tea Co. is a Southern sweet tea brand founded in 2015 by Wes Willis (musician) and Golson Foshee (real estate developer) in Montgomery, Alabama. Born out of family tradition and a love for the Deep South, the company crafts sweet tea using a custom blend of high-quality loose-leaf tea leaves, pure cane sugar, and hand-squeezed fruit juice — no artificial ingredients or preservatives. Originally a food truck popping up at events across Alabama, they parked at the Magnolia Food Truck Park (The Silos) in Waco, Texas in 2022, and also operate a storefront at The Wharf in Orange Beach, Alabama. They sell tea, apparel, drinkware, gifts, and accessories online and in-store.
about.elevator_pitch: Alabama Sweet Tea Co. bottles the soul of the South in every sip, crafting preservative-free sweet tea from premium loose-leaf leaves and pure cane sugar — a taste rooted in family tradition and available online, in Waco TX, and Orange Beach AL.
about.vibe: Southern charm, nostalgic, family-rooted, classic Americana
